instruction.text: Which sentence displays an over-exaggeration of the following state of being?

finish.text:
I’m so hungry, I could eat a horse. – I’m literally dying of boredom.

These two exaggerated statements were examples of hyperboles. Hyperboles are used to invoke a feeling or to create an image and are usually not meant to be taken literally.

instruction.text: Look at the underlined hyperbole in each sentence, then select what it means in this sentence.

atoms.a: My grandfather’s computer is <u>200 years old</u>.
Evelyn <u>was on fire</u> on the basketball court last night.
b: was burning people with her moves

atoms.a: Jeremy <u>is drowning in</u> all the work he hasn’t done yet.
The comedian made me <u>die of laughter</u>.
Veronica mentioned <u>a million times</u> that they should wipe down the table after using it.
b: so often that one could only forget it

atoms.a: The house cost the newly wedded couple <u>an arm and a leg</u>.
I remember when my little sister was <u>as light as a feather</u> and I could carry her on my shoulders.
